programs.title: Interview With the Vampire
programs.desc: Living in 1910 New Orleans as his family's executor-in-charge, Louis's life begins to unravel in otherworldly ways when he meets Lestat, a vampire; in 2020, Louis tells his story to journalist Molloy.

programs.title: Interview With the Vampire
programs.sub_title: ...After the Phantoms of Your Former Self
programs.desc: Beginning his life as a vampire, Louis learns the rules of vampirism from his maker and companion Lestat; Louis discovers increasing differences between himself and Lestat; in Dubai, Louis reveals more of his modern-day vampire lifestyle to Molloy.

programs.title: Interview With the Vampire
programs.sub_title: Is My Very Nature That of the Devil
programs.desc: Louis continues his life as a businessman of Storyville; when an old friend comes to town, Louis' relationship with Lestat is tested; Louis' business intertwines with growing tensions in New Orleans, leading to a new chapter in Louis' vampire life.

programs.title: Interview With the Vampire
programs.sub_title: ...The Ruthless Pursuit of Blood With All a Child's Demanding
programs.desc: Claudia's transformation into a vampire teen completely changes Louis and Lestat's lives; as Claudia asks more questions, Louis and Lestat are forced to confront questions about making a teen vampire; Claudia learns dark realities of her new life.

programs.title: Interview With the Vampire
programs.sub_title: A Vile Hunger for Your Hammering Heart
programs.desc: Claudia's activities and curiosities present continued challenges for Louis and Lestat; her actions light an explosive fuse.

programs.title: Interview With the Vampire
programs.sub_title: Like Angels Put in Hell by God
programs.desc: Lestat attempts to make amends with Louis; the vampire family decides to live together once more; an action from Lestat leads the family to decide to leave New Orleans, once and for all; in Dubai, Molloy has a realization.

programs.title: Interview With the Vampire
programs.desc: The vampire family plans to leave town after a big Mardi Gras ball; Claudia and Louis operate outside of Lestat's knowledge; in Dubai, Louis reveals a new element to the interview that changes everything.

programs.title: Interview With the Vampire
programs.sub_title: What Can the Damned Really Say to the Damned
programs.desc: Louis recounts about Claudia's quest to find Old World Vampires amid the backdrop of Europe during WWII.

programs.title: Interview With the Vampire
programs.sub_title: Do You Know What It Means to Be Loved by Death
programs.desc: Armand joins the interview, and he and Louis tell Molloy the story of how they met.

programs.title: Interview With the Vampire
programs.desc: Armand tells the history of the Theatre des Vampires; Louis tells of his reluctance to join.

programs.title: Interview With the Vampire
programs.sub_title: I Want You More Than Anything in the World
programs.desc: The coven questions Louis and Armand's special relationship; Claudia finds a new friend.
